Align MS and FID retention times

align_detectors.Rd

Estimates the retention-time delay between the MS and the FID and records it in the experiment. Raw times are never changed; downstream functions subtract the delay from MS times.

Usage

align_detectors(exp, engine = NULL)

Arguments

exp

A gcms_fid_exp object.

engine

"xcorr" (default) or "gcalignr". NULL uses the moosaic.align_engine option.

Value

exp with alignment set to a list of delay (min; positive when MS times are later than FID times), engine, score (cross-correlation at the delay), validated (FALSE) and cross_check (engine and delay of the xcorr cross-check; both NA when no cross-check was run). The step is logged in processing$align_detectors.

Details

Cross-correlation alone is sufficient to align the FID with the MS for guiding deconvolution windows, so with engine = "xcorr" GCalignR is not run. With engine = "gcalignr", xcorr is run as a cheap cross-check; a warning of class engine_disagreement is issued when the two delays differ by more than one MS scan interval. If GCalignR cannot run because too few peaks are found, the cross-correlation result is used with a warning of class engine_fallback. Search range and step come from the moosaic.max_delay and moosaic.align_step options.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  exp <- align_detectors(exp)
} # }
